# Welcome to Nexolith Discussions

Use Discussions for questions, ideas, architecture exploration, benchmarks, and research that are not yet defined enough for an issue.

Please search first, identify the relevant roadmap horizon, separate facts from assumptions, and include reproducible evidence for technical claims. Planned features are not promises. Once a proposal has bounded scope and acceptance criteria, convert it into a linked issue.

Do not post security vulnerabilities, private information, proprietary Minecraft code or assets, or sensitive conduct reports publicly.
